info.title: FoodOnTheGo API
info.description: Contract for /api/v1. Conventions: snake_case JSON; single resources are returned unwrapped; collections are {data, links, meta}; every error is {error: {code, message, details?, request_id}}; money is {amount, currency} with amount in integer minor units and an ISO 4217 currency; identifiers are public UUIDs (internal numeric ids are never exposed); timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC; countries are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; time zones are IANA ids. Every response carries X-Request-Id. Authentication: three separate bearer-token contexts (customer, restaurant, admin); a token is accepted only by routes of its own context, the account state is re-checked on every request, and sensitive endpoints are rate limited (429 rate_limited with Retry-After). tests/Feature/Foundation/OpenApiContractTest.php fails when the routes or the documented response shapes drift from this file.

post.summary: Send a one-time code. Channels are tried cheapest first (e.g. WhatsApp, then SMS): the first code uses the first channel, each resend the next; `channel` asks for a specific one. Same answer for new and existing customers; never returns the code. Limits: per phone and per address per minute, resend cooldown, hourly cap per phone
Verify the code and sign in. Creates the customer on first use (201). Errors: otp_invalid (details.attempts_left), otp_expired, otp_attempts_exceeded (429), account_not_active (403)

201.description: New customer created and signed in

patch.summary: Update the signed-in customer's own name, e-mail, locale; accept the terms

post.summary: Restaurant user sign-in with e-mail and password. With MFA enabled the answer is a challenge, not a token. Errors: invalid_credentials (401, generic), account_not_active (403)
Restaurant user: complete sign-in with a TOTP code or a recovery code. Errors: mfa_challenge_invalid (401), mfa_code_invalid (422), mfa_attempts_exceeded (429)
Restaurant user: request a password reset link. The answer is identical whether or not the account exists
Restaurant user: set a new password with a reset token (expiring, single use). All sessions are signed out. Error: reset_token_invalid
Admin user sign-in with e-mail and password. With MFA enabled the answer is a challenge, not a token. Errors: invalid_credentials (401, generic), account_not_active (403)
Admin user: complete sign-in with a TOTP code or a recovery code. Errors: mfa_challenge_invalid (401), mfa_code_invalid (422), mfa_attempts_exceeded (429)
Admin user: request a password reset link. The answer is identical whether or not the account exists
Admin user: set a new password with a reset token (expiring, single use). All sessions are signed out. Error: reset_token_invalid

customer.description: Opaque access token of a customer. Stored hashed, expiring, revocable. Not accepted by routes of another context.

restaurant.description: Opaque access token of a restaurant user. Stored hashed, expiring, revocable. Not accepted by routes of another context.

admin.description: Opaque access token of a admin user. Stored hashed, expiring, revocable. Not accepted by routes of another context.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. validation_failed, unauthenticated, forbidden, not_found, conflict, rate_limited, internal_error, or a domain code such as market_unavailable

debug.description: Only when APP_DEBUG is on (never in production)

phone_country_code.description: UX default for phone inputs, not a validation rule

phone.description: Any common format; normalised to E.164 by the server in the market's context

country.description: Market of the number; defaults to the default market

channel.description: Optional: ask for this channel instead of the automatic order

resend_available_at.description: Server decides; the client countdown is decoration

delivery.description: live = a real message was sent on `channel`; development = local / testing, nothing was sent. The code itself is never returned

resend_channel.description: Channel a resend would start with

permissions.description: Distinct permission codes held in any scope — display convenience only

mfa_enrollment_required.description: true = this token can only enrol in MFA

CoverageStatus.description: Service areas and route corridors. Only ACTIVE serves customers; TESTING is internal.

GeoJsonGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry (RFC 7946): WGS84, positions are [longitude, latitude]. No "crs" member is accepted.

country_code.description: Hint from the places provider; a value that contradicts the market means "not this market"

LocationInput.description: One shape for a place across the API. Only the coordinates are used for decisions.

reason.description: Set exactly when supported is false

route_corridors.description: Operational corridors whose band contains the point (supported locations only)

Coverage.description: Customer-safe display data. Regions/cities: PLANNED, PILOT, ACTIVE, PAUSED. Service areas: ACTIVE in effect and PAUSED. Corridors: ACTIVE in effect.

phone_country_code.description: UX default for phone inputs, not a validation rule

serving_customers.description: City and its region are both open

ServiceArea.description: Lists carry the summary only; geometry is present on single records and on the map endpoint.
